decisions.reason: VueTOC was a narrow experimental mobile component that has not appeared on the website since 2018, and the firm can carry what it learned into its platform and mobile offerings, as it already did with the other small plugins.

The GIS platform is the flagship that rests directly on the firm's core engineering knowledge, research and standards work, so even without recent website visibility it remains the vehicle for absorbing new technologies into customer solutions.

Mobile field data capture builds closely on the firm's GIS and mobile competence and serves an ongoing need among public and private customers, but its missing website presence after 2018 signals some risk that it is being merged into the platform.
